json_schema.description: Opens when a result lands for a contract somebody owns. The event log IS the notification queue, and this is what makes a LOST delivery recoverable rather than assumed: the contract stays open until notify_acked closes it at the recipient's next turn boundary, so a delivery that never arrived is visible as outstanding work instead of vanishing. Appended BEFORE the injection is attempted, deliberately — a failed injection then leaves a sweepable record, where the reverse order would deliver with no trace. NOT spillable (contract event).
